items.title: What Is Ford Motor (F) Signaling With Its New U.S. EV Battery Cells?
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) has started producing lithium iron phosphate EV battery cells in the U.S. using CATL technology. The new cells are intended to supply Ford's upcoming electric models, including the Fathom pickup, with lower-cost batteries. Domestic output of CATL based cells marks a shift toward localized battery manufacturing for Ford's future EV lineup. items.title: Ford begins EV battery cell production in the U.S. with China’s tech
